name: perp-cli
description: Multi-DEX perpetual futures trading via the perp-cli command-line tool. Use when user asks to: trade perps, check funding rates, scan/execute arbitrage (perp-perp or spot-perp), run delta-neutral strategies, bridge USDC across chains, manage positions/orders/leverage, deposit/withdraw, hedge spot+perp, trade HIP-3 DEXes, read Derive options chains, use Pacifica Print or Pacifica vaults, or mentions perp-cli, hypurrquant, Pacifica, Hyperliquid, Lighter, Aster, Lighter RH, Ondo Perps, Arcus, QFEX, RISEx, TxFlow, Variational, GRVT, Extended, Derive, HyperEVM, funding arb, or U-tokens (UBTC/UETH/USOL). Covers Pacifica (Solana), Hyperliquid (HyperEVM), Lighter (Ethereum), Aster (BNB Chain), Lighter RH and Arcus (Robinhood chain), Ondo Perps and QFEX (off-chain), RISEx (RISE chain), TxFlow (manual trading; mainnet whitelisted; official API in Beta), Variational Omni (market data only, official API), GRVT and Extended (Starknet) (market data only for now, official API), Derive options (read-only), and Pacifica Print / vaults.

findings.excerpt: compatibility: "Requires Node.js 20 or newer and the perp-cli npm package installed by the user (version must be >= 0.17.0; the user runs `npm install -g perp-c
perp --version         # must be >= 0.17.0
If `perp` is missing or older, STOP and ask the user to install / upgrade it (`npm install -g perp-cli`) — never install it yourself and never switch to `npx`.
perp --json wallet show               # with an OWS wallet, `exchanges: []` is normal — owsActiveWallet serves every venue
printf '%s' "$EVM_HEX_KEY" | OWS_PASSPHRASE=<pp> perp --json wallet set hl          # Hyperliquid / Lighter / Aster (EVM)
perp --json wallet agent approve lighter-rh
printf '%s' "$AGENT_KEY" | perp --json wallet agent import hyperliquid               # master read from HL
perp --json arb scan                              # all modes (perp-perp + spot-perp), default --min 10 (% annual)
perp --json -e hyperliquid market hip3                               # deployed dexes: name, deployer, assets, delistedAssets, delisted
perp --json -e derive options expiries ETH                              # active expiries
perp --json portfolio -e <longEx>                     # perp.available (long leg)
perp --json -e <ex> market info <SYM>                                    # markPrice, stepSize (lot), maxLeverage
perp --json arb exec <SYM> <longEx> <shortEx> <USD> --smart
perp --json -e <ex> trade limit <SYM> buy|sell <PRICE> <SIZE> [--tif GTC|IOC|FOK|ALO] [--reduce-only]   # default GTC
perp --json arb status                              # open arb positions, PnL, funding earned
perp --json arb close <SYM>                                     # perp-perp arb
perp --json funds deposit hyperliquid 100
perp strategy list-strategies                                 # 20 registered
perp --json --dry-run arb auto --min-spread 30 --size 100     # simulate first (--background inherits --dry-run)
perp --json arb scan --min 10 --top 10
perp --json arb scan --mode spot-perp --min 0       # ETH row must say direction "long-spot-short-perp"
perp --json -e hl trade check SOL buy 0.5 --leverage 2
"command": "npx",
- 'scan: no curl|sh / wget|sh pattern matched'
